notes: Held-out test set: never used to tune prompts, data or training (the pilot, eval/eval-set.json, is the dev set). Same conventions as the pilot: Hand-written questions with two independently written gold queries each (gold_sql, alt_sql); npm run eval:verify runs both and requires the same result. expect: answer | refuse | clarify. as_user 'top_student' = the seeded student with the most deals. items.alt_sql: with r as (select l.category, sum(d.agreed_price) as revenue, row_number() over (order by sum(d.agreed_price) desc) as rn from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d using (item_id) where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category) select category, revenue from r where rn <= 3 order by rn

items.question: compare the late-return rate for rentals due on weekends with rentals due on weekdays
items.gold_sql: select c.is_weekend, round(avg(d.returned_late::int), 4) as late_rate from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.rental_due_date where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null group by c.is_weekend
items.alt_sql: select extract(isodow from rental_due_date) in (6, 7) as weekend, round(sum(case when returned_late then 1 else 0 end)::numeric / count(*), 4) from nlq.deals where return_condition is not null group by 1

items.question: how many items were rented out at some point and later sold?
items.gold_sql: select count(distinct s.item_id) from nlq.deals s where s.deal_type = 'sale' and s.status = 'completed' and exists (select 1 from nlq.deals r where r.item_id = s.item_id and r.deal_type = 'rental' and r.status = 'completed' and r.completed_at < s.completed_at)
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from (select s.item_id from nlq.deals s join nlq.deals r on r.item_id = s.item_id where s.deal_type = 'sale' and s.status = 'completed' and r.deal_type = 'rental' and r.status = 'completed' group by s.item_id having min(r.completed_at) < max(s.completed_at)) x

items.question: average number of days from listing to completed sale, for each meetup spot
items.gold_sql: select m.name, round(avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at - l.listed_at) / 86400), 1) from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by m.name
items.alt_sql: with x as (select l.spot_id, extract(epoch from d.completed_at) - extract(epoch from l.listed_at) as secs from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d using (item_id) where d.status = 'completed' and d.deal_type = 'sale') select m.name, round(avg(secs) / 86400, 1) from x join nlq.meetup_spots m using (spot_id) group by m.name

items.question: in 2025, which month saw the biggest increase in completed deals over the month before?
items.gold_sql: with m as (select c.month_name, c.month, count(*) as n from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.status = 'completed' and c.year = 2025 group by c.month_name, c.month), prev as (select count(*) as n from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and completed_on between '2024-12-01' and '2024-12-31'), j as (select month_name, n - coalesce(lag(n) over (order by month), (select n from prev)) as jump from m) select month_name from j order by jump desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', completed_on) as mo, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and completed_on >= '2024-12-01' and completed_on < '2026-01-01' group by 1), j as (select mo, n - lag(n) over (order by mo) as jump from m) select to_char(mo, 'FMMonth') from j where extract(year from mo) = 2025 order by jump desc limit 1
accept_sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', completed_on)::date as mo, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and completed_on >= '2024-12-01' and completed_on < '2026-01-01' group by 1) select mo from (select mo, n - lag(n) over (order by mo) as jump from m) j where mo >= '2025-01-01' order by jump desc limit 1

items.question: of the students who completed a purchase in fall 2024, what percent completed another purchase in spring 2025?
items.gold_sql: with f as (select distinct d.buyer_id from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year = '2024-25'), s as (select distinct d.buyer_id from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.semester = 'Spring' and c.academic_year = '2024-25') select round(100.0 * count(s.buyer_id) / count(*), 2) from f left join s on s.buyer_id = f.buyer_id
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * avg(case when exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d2 where d2.buyer_id = f.buyer_id and d2.deal_type = 'sale' and d2.status = 'completed' and d2.completed_on in (select day from nlq.calendar where semester = 'Spring' and academic_year = '2024-25')) then 1 else 0 end), 2) from (select distinct buyer_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' and completed_on in (select day from nlq.calendar where semester = 'Fall' and academic_year = '2024-25')) f

items.question: completed-sale revenue for each fall semester from 2023 through 2025, in order
items.gold_sql: select c.academic_year, sum(d.agreed_price) as revenue from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year in ('2023-24', '2024-25', '2025-26') group by c.academic_year order by c.academic_year
items.alt_sql: select extract(year from d.completed_on) || '-' || lpad(((extract(year from d.completed_on)::int + 1) % 100)::text, 2, '0') as yr, sum(d.agreed_price) from nlq.deals d where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_on in (select day from nlq.calendar where semester = 'Fall') and extract(year from d.completed_on) between 2023 and 2025 group by 1 order by 1

items.question: which category's completed rentals went up the most from 2024 to 2025?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category order by count(*) filter (where extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2025) - count(*) filter (where extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2024) desc limit 1

items.question: what's the median number of days between a listing going up and it selling?

items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reports r join nlq.calendar c on c.day = r.filed_on where r.target_type = 'deal' and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year = '2025-26'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.reports where target_type = 'deal' and filed_on in (select day from nlq.calendar where semester = 'Fall' and academic_year = '2025-26')

items.question: average deposit asked on bike & scooter listings that could be rented
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(rent_deposit), 2) from nlq.listings_all where category = 'bikes_transport' and rent_price_per_week is not null
items.alt_sql: select round(sum(rent_deposit) / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all where category = 'bikes_transport' and is_for_rent

items.question: how many chats were started during move-in periods?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.conversations v join nlq.calendar c on c.day = v.started_on where c.period = 'move-in'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.conversations where started_on in (select day from nlq.calendar where period = 'move-in')

items.question: average rating buyers gave sellers on deals for items picked up at IV
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(r.rating), 2) from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' and m.name = 'International Village'
items.alt_sql: select round(avg(rating), 2) from nlq.reviews where reviewer_role = 'buyer' and deal_id in (select d.deal_id from nlq.deals d where d.item_id in (select item_id from nlq.listings_all where spot_id = (select spot_id from nlq.meetup_spots where name = 'International Village')))

items.question: what percentage of listings in good condition ended up being taken down (removed)?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((status = 'removed')::int), 2) from nlq.listings_all where condition = 'good'
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where status = 'removed') / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all where condition = 'good'

items.question: median asking sale price in each category
items.gold_sql: select category, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by sale_price) as median_price from nlq.listings_all where sale_price is not null group by category
items.alt_sql:
with r as (select category, sale_price, row_number() over (partition by category order by sale_price) as rn, count(*) over (partition by category) as n from nlq.listings_all where sale_price is not null)
  select category, avg(sale_price) as median_price from r where rn in ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) group by category

items.question: for each month of 2025, what share of new chats turned into a request?
items.gold_sql: select extract(month from started_on) as month, round(100.0 * avg(led_to_request::int), 2) as pct from nlq.conversations where started_on between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1 order by 1
items.alt_sql: select c.month, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where v.led_to_request) / count(*), 2) as pct from nlq.conversations v join nlq.calendar c on c.day = v.started_on where c.year = 2025 group by c.month order by c.month

items.question: at which meetup spot do sellers reply to new chats the fastest, on average?
items.gold_sql: select m.name from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = c.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id group by m.name order by avg(c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at) asc limit 1
items.alt_sql:
with t as (select l.spot_id, avg(extract(epoch from c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at)) as secs from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l using (item_id) where c.first_seller_reply_at is not null group by l.spot_id)
  select m.name from t join nlq.meetup_spots m using (spot_id) where t.secs = (select min(secs) from t)

items.question: how many students have both hearted something and posted a listing, but never opened a chat as a buyer?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s where exists (select 1 from nlq.saved_items x where x.student_id = s.student_id) and exists (select 1 from nlq.listings_all l where l.seller_id = s.student_id) and not exists (select 1 from nlq.conversations c where c.buyer_id = s.student_id)
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from ((select student_id from nlq.saved_items intersect select seller_id from nlq.listings_all) except select buyer_id from nlq.conversations) t

items.question: of the students who joined in 2025, how many posted their first listing within 30 days of signing up?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s join (select seller_id, min(listed_at) as first_listed from nlq.listings_all group by seller_id) f on f.seller_id = s.student_id where extract(year from (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')) = 2025 and f.first_listed <= s.joined_at + interval '30 days'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s where (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' and exists (select 1 from nlq.listings_all l where l.seller_id = s.student_id and extract(epoch from l.listed_at - s.joined_at) <= 30 * 86400)
accept_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s join (select seller_id, min(listed_on) as first_on from nlq.listings_all group by seller_id) f on f.seller_id = s.student_id where extract(year from (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')) = 2025 and f.first_on - (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date <= 30

items.question: sell-through rate for each category group
items.gold_sql: select c.category_group, round(100.0 * avg((l.status = 'sold')::int), 2) as sell_through from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.categories c on c.category = l.category group by c.category_group
items.alt_sql: select c.category_group, round(100.0 * sum(case when l.status = 'sold' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) as sell_through from nlq.categories c join nlq.listings_all l using (category) group by 1

items.question: what percent of resolved reports were closed out within 48 hours of being filed?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((resolved_at - filed_at <= interval '48 hours')::int), 2) from nlq.reports where status = 'resolved'
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where extract(epoch from resolved_at - filed_at) <= 2 * 86400) / count(*), 2) from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null and status = 'resolved'

items.question: split by whether a report was about a deal, a listing or a student: how many days did moderators take on average to close it out?
items.gold_sql: select target_type, round(avg(extract(epoch from resolved_at - filed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null group by target_type
items.alt_sql: select target_type, round((sum(extract(epoch from resolved_at - filed_at)) / count(*) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from nlq.reports where status = 'resolved' group by target_type
accept_sql: select target_type, round(avg((resolved_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date - filed_on), 2) as avg_days from nlq.reports where resolved_at is not null group by target_type

items.question: which calendar month, counting every year together, sees the most new listings?
items.gold_sql: select c.month_name from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on group by c.month_name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: with m as (select extract(month from listed_on) as mo, count(*) as n from nlq.listings_all group by 1) select to_char(make_date(2000, mo::int, 1), 'FMMonth') as month_name from m where n = (select max(n) from m)

items.question: listings that at least 5 different students hearted: how many of them are reserved right now?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings_all where status = 'reserved' and item_id in (select item_id from nlq.saved_items group by item_id having count(distinct student_id) >= 5)
items.alt_sql: with popular as (select item_id from nlq.saved_items group by item_id having count(distinct student_id) >= 5) select sum((l.status = 'reserved')::int) from popular p join nlq.listings_all l using (item_id)

items.question: rank the meetup spots by how many conversations their listings have drawn, most first
items.gold_sql: select m.name, count(*) as conversations from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = c.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id group by m.name order by conversations desc
items.alt_sql: select m.name, (select count(*) from nlq.conversations c where c.item_id in (select item_id from nlq.listings_all l where l.spot_id = m.spot_id)) as conversations from nlq.meetup_spots m order by 2 desc

items.question: for each academic year, how many distinct students posted at least one item?
items.gold_sql: select c.academic_year, count(distinct l.seller_id) as sellers from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on group by c.academic_year
items.alt_sql: select case when extract(month from listed_on) >= 7 then extract(year from listed_on)::int || '-' || lpad(((extract(year from listed_on)::int + 1) % 100)::text, 2, '0') else (extract(year from listed_on)::int - 1) || '-' || lpad((extract(year from listed_on)::int % 100)::text, 2, '0') end as academic_year, count(distinct seller_id) as sellers from nlq.listings_all group by 1

items.question: on average, how many days after an item is listed does its first chat start? (only items that got a chat)
items.gold_sql: select round(avg(extract(epoch from f.first_chat - l.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from nlq.listings_all l join (select item_id, min(started_at) as first_chat from nlq.conversations group by item_id) f on f.item_id = l.item_id
items.alt_sql: with firsts as (select distinct on (c.item_id) c.item_id, c.started_at from nlq.conversations c order by c.item_id, c.started_at) select round((sum(extract(epoch from f.started_at - l.listed_at)) / count(*) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from firsts f join nlq.listings_all l using (item_id)
accept_sql: select round(avg(f.first_on - l.listed_on), 2) from nlq.listings_all l join (select item_id, min(started_on) as first_on from nlq.conversations group by item_id) f on f.item_id = l.item_id

items.question: among sellers who have been rated by buyers, what percent average 4.5 stars or better from those buyer ratings?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((avg_rating >= 4.5)::int), 2) from (select reviewee_id, avg(rating) as avg_rating from nlq.reviews where reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by reviewee_id) t
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * (select count(*) from (select reviewee_id from nlq.reviews where reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by reviewee_id having avg(rating) >= 4.5) a) / count(distinct reviewee_id), 2) from nlq.reviews where reviewer_role = 'buyer'

items.question: year by year, what percentage of new listings came with 3 or more photos?
items.gold_sql: select extract(year from listed_on) as year, round(100.0 * avg((photo_count >= 3)::int), 2) as pct from nlq.listings_all group by 1
items.alt_sql: select c.year, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where l.photo_count >= 3) / count(*), 2) as pct from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on group by c.year

items.question: per category, where do most successful purchases get handed off? give the top pickup location for each
items.gold_sql: with c as (select l.category, s.name, count(*) as n from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category, s.name), r as (select category, name, rank() over (partition by category order by n desc) as rk from c) select category, name as spot from r where rk = 1
items.alt_sql: with sales as (select l.category, m.name as spot, count(d.deal_id) as sales from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id group by 1, 2) select s.category, s.spot from sales s join (select category, max(sales) as top from sales group by category) t on t.category = s.category and t.top = s.sales

items.question: show the 2025 sales swing: each month's change in the number of purchases that went through relative to the month prior
items.gold_sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', completed_on)::date as month, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' and completed_on >= '2024-12-01' and completed_on < '2026-01-01' group by 1) select month, change from (select month, n - lag(n) over (order by month) as change from m) x where month >= '2025-01-01' order by month
items.alt_sql: with m as (select extract(year from completed_on)::int as yr, extract(month from completed_on)::int as mo, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by 1, 2) select make_date(cur.yr, cur.mo, 1) as month, cur.n - prev.n as change from m cur join m prev on make_date(prev.yr, prev.mo, 1) = make_date(cur.yr, cur.mo, 1) - interval '1 month' where cur.yr = 2025 order by 1
accept_sql: with m as (select date_trunc('month', completed_on)::date as month, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' and extract(year from completed_on) = 2025 group by 1) select month, n - lag(n) over (order by month) as change from m order by month

items.question: running tally of reviews written during 2025, building up month after month
items.gold_sql: select date_trunc('month', reviewed_on)::date as month, sum(count(*)) over (order by date_trunc('month', reviewed_on)::date) as running_total from nlq.reviews where reviewed_on between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1 order by 1
items.alt_sql: with months as (select distinct date_trunc('month', reviewed_on)::date as m from nlq.reviews where extract(year from reviewed_on) = 2025) select m as month, (select count(*) from nlq.reviews r where r.reviewed_on >= '2025-01-01' and r.reviewed_on < m + interval '1 month') as running_total from months order by m

items.question: what's the median agreed price on completed sales in each category?
items.gold_sql: select l.category, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by d.agreed_price) as median_price from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category
items.alt_sql: with r as (select l.category, d.agreed_price, row_number() over (partition by l.category order by d.agreed_price) as rn, count(*) over (partition by l.category) as cnt from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed') select category, avg(agreed_price) as median_price from r where rn in ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) group by category
accept_sql: select l.category, percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by d.agreed_price) as median_price from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category

items.question: fall 2025 signup cohort: how many of those new accounts have since closed a sale as the seller?
items.gold_sql: select count(distinct s.student_id) from nlq.students s join nlq.calendar c on c.day = (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date join nlq.deals d on d.seller_id = s.student_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' where c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year = '2025-26'
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.students s where exists (select 1 from nlq.calendar c where c.day = (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year = '2025-26') and s.student_id in (select seller_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed')

items.question: what share of buyers came back and made a second completed purchase?
items.gold_sql: with b as (select buyer_id, count(*) as n from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by buyer_id) select round(100.0 * avg((n > 1)::int), 2) as repeat_pct from b
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(distinct case when rn = 2 then buyer_id end) / count(distinct buyer_id), 2) from (select buyer_id, row_number() over (partition by buyer_id order by completed_at) as rn from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') x

items.question: how many items that were ever put up have zero bookmarks from anyone?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings_all l where not exists (select 1 from nlq.saved_items s where s.item_id = l.item_id)
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings_all l left join (select distinct item_id from nlq.saved_items) s on s.item_id = l.item_id where s.item_id is null

items.question: among sellers with at least 5 completed sales, how many average under 4 stars from the buyers who reviewed those sales?
items.gold_sql: with s as (select seller_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by seller_id having count(*) >= 5) select count(*) from (select r.reviewee_id from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and r.reviewee_id in (select seller_id from s) group by r.reviewee_id having avg(r.rating) < 4) x
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from (select d.seller_id, count(distinct d.deal_id) as sales, avg(r.rating) filter (where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer') as rating from nlq.deals d left join nlq.reviews r on r.deal_id = d.deal_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by d.seller_id) t where sales >= 5 and rating < 4

items.question: do chats that turn into a request get a faster first reply? average seller reply time in hours for conversations that led to a request vs ones that didn't
items.gold_sql: select led_to_request, round(avg(extract(epoch from first_seller_reply_at - started_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as hours from nlq.conversations group by led_to_request
items.alt_sql: select true as led, round(avg(extract(epoch from first_seller_reply_at - started_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as hours from nlq.conversations where led_to_request union all select false, round(avg(extract(epoch from first_seller_reply_at - started_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) from nlq.conversations where not led_to_request

items.question: per school year (July to June), what fraction of finalized deals were rentals as opposed to sales?
items.gold_sql: select c.academic_year, round(100.0 * avg((d.deal_type = 'rental')::int), 2) as rental_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.status = 'completed' group by c.academic_year
items.alt_sql: select c.academic_year, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where d.deal_type = 'rental') / count(*), 2) from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.completed_on = c.day and d.status = 'completed' group by 1

items.question: what share of all the money from completed sales went to the top 10 sellers by sales revenue?
items.gold_sql: with s as (select seller_id, sum(agreed_price) as rev from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by seller_id) select round(100.0 * (select sum(rev) from (select rev from s order by rev desc limit 10) t) / (select sum(rev) from s), 2) as top10_pct
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * sum(rev) filter (where rk <= 10) / sum(rev), 2) from (select seller_id, sum(agreed_price) as rev, row_number() over (order by sum(agreed_price) desc) as rk from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by seller_id) x

items.question: for buyers with at least two completed purchases, how many days pass on average between their first and second one?
items.gold_sql: with p as (select buyer_id, completed_at, row_number() over (partition by buyer_id order by completed_at) as rn from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') select round(avg(extract(epoch from b.completed_at - a.completed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 1) as avg_days from p a join p b on a.buyer_id = b.buyer_id and a.rn = 1 and b.rn = 2
items.alt_sql: select round(avg(gap)::numeric, 1) from (select extract(epoch from lead(completed_at) over (partition by buyer_id order by completed_at) - completed_at) / 86400 as gap, row_number() over (partition by buyer_id order by completed_at) as rn from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') x where rn = 1 and gap is not null
accept_sql: with p as (select buyer_id, completed_on, row_number() over (partition by buyer_id order by completed_at) as rn from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') select round(avg(b.completed_on - a.completed_on), 1) from p a join p b on a.buyer_id = b.buyer_id and a.rn = 1 and b.rn = 2

items.question: going by the day rentals were due, which weekday has the worst late-return rate?
items.gold_sql: select c.weekday_name from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.rental_due_date where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null group by c.weekday_name order by avg(d.returned_late::int) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select weekday_name from (select c.weekday_name, rank() over (order by count(*) filter (where d.returned_late)::numeric / count(*) desc) as rk from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.rental_due_date = c.day where d.rental_returned_at is not null group by c.weekday_name) x where rk = 1

items.question: which categories got pricier to borrow in 2025 than in 2024, going by the average agreed price on borrowings that finished?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category having avg(d.agreed_price) filter (where extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2025) > avg(d.agreed_price) filter (where extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2024)
items.alt_sql: with y24 as (select l.category, avg(d.agreed_price) as p from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l using (item_id) where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_on between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31' group by 1), y25 as (select l.category, avg(d.agreed_price) as p from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l using (item_id) where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_on between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1) select y25.category from y25 join y24 on y24.category = y25.category where y25.p > y24.p

items.question: how many students have both lent something out and borrowed something, counting only rentals that went through?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select seller_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and status = 'completed' intersect select buyer_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and status = 'completed') x
items.alt_sql: select count(distinct d.seller_id) from nlq.deals d where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.status = 'completed' and exists (select 1 from nlq.deals b where b.buyer_id = d.seller_id and b.deal_type = 'rental' and b.status = 'completed')

items.question: for each category, what percent of listings ever posted got at least one chat?
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.conversations c where c.item_id = l.item_id))::int), 2) as pct_with_chat from nlq.listings_all l group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * count(distinct c.item_id) / count(distinct l.item_id), 2) from nlq.listings_all l left join nlq.conversations c on c.item_id = l.item_id group by l.category

items.question: 2025-26 school year: by term (fall, spring, summer 1, summer 2), what percent of rentals came back after their due date, based on when they were due?
items.gold_sql: select c.semester, round(100.0 * avg(d.returned_late::int), 2) as late_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.rental_due_date where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null and c.academic_year = '2025-26' and c.semester in ('Fall', 'Spring', 'Summer 1', 'Summer 2') group by c.semester
items.alt_sql: select c.semester, round(100.0 * sum(case when d.returned_late then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.rental_due_date = c.day where d.return_condition is not null and c.academic_year = '2025-26' and c.semester <> 'Break' group by c.semester

items.question: how many students have posted at least one listing but never completed a sale?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select distinct seller_id from nlq.listings_all) s where not exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.seller_id = s.seller_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed')
items.alt_sql: select count(distinct l.seller_id) from nlq.listings_all l left join (select distinct seller_id from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed') d on d.seller_id = l.seller_id where d.seller_id is null

items.question: 2024 signups: what percent of them had a purchase go through within their first 30 days on the app?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.buyer_id = s.student_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_at <= s.joined_at + interval '30 days'))::int), 2) as pct from nlq.students s where extract(year from (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')) = 2024
items.alt_sql: with c as (select student_id, joined_at from nlq.students where (joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31'), q as (select distinct c.student_id from c join nlq.deals d on d.buyer_id = c.student_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_at - c.joined_at <= interval '30 days') select round(100.0 * (select count(*) from q) / (select count(*) from c), 2)

items.question: what hour of the day, Boston time, do the most conversations get started?
items.gold_sql: select extract(hour from started_at at time zone 'America/New_York') as hour from nlq.conversations group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select h from (select date_part('hour', timezone('America/New_York', started_at)) as h, count(*) as n from nlq.conversations group by 1) x where n = (select max(n) from (select count(*) as n from nlq.conversations group by date_part('hour', timezone('America/New_York', started_at))) y)

items.question: for each category, what share of its completed sales happened during finals?
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * avg((c.period = 'finals')::int), 2) as finals_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where c.period = 'finals') / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on group by 1

items.question: between 2024 and 2025, which handoff location added the most newly posted items, by count?
items.gold_sql: select s.name from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id group by s.name order by count(*) filter (where extract(year from l.listed_on) = 2025) - count(*) filter (where extract(year from l.listed_on) = 2024) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: with y as (select spot_id, extract(year from listed_on) as yr, count(*) as n from nlq.listings_all where listed_on between '2024-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1, 2) select m.name from y a join y b on b.spot_id = a.spot_id and a.yr = 2024 and b.yr = 2025 join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = a.spot_id order by b.n - a.n desc limit 1

items.question: do listings with 3 or more photos sell faster? average days from listing to completed sale for 3+ photos vs fewer
items.gold_sql: select l.photo_count >= 3 as three_plus, round(avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at - l.listed_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by 1
items.alt_sql: select (case when l.photo_count < 3 then false else true end) as photos, round((avg(extract(epoch from d.completed_at) - extract(epoch from l.listed_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by 1

items.question: on completed sales, what's the average discount off the asking price, as a percent, for each category? leave out free items
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(avg(100.0 * (l.sale_price - d.agreed_price) / l.sale_price), 2) as avg_discount_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and l.sale_price > 0 group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select l.category, round(100 * avg(1 - d.agreed_price / nullif(l.sale_price, 0)), 2) from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and l.sale_price <> 0 group by 1

items.question: how many students have gotten both a 1-star and a 5-star review?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select reviewee_id from nlq.reviews group by reviewee_id having bool_or(rating = 1) and bool_or(rating = 5)) x
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from (select reviewee_id from nlq.reviews where rating = 1 intersect select reviewee_id from nlq.reviews where rating = 5) x

items.question: average star rating split by deal type and by who left the review, buyer or seller
items.gold_sql: select d.deal_type, r.reviewer_role, round(avg(r.rating), 2) as avg_rating from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id group by d.deal_type, r.reviewer_role
items.alt_sql: select d.deal_type, 'buyer' as who, round(sum(r.rating)::numeric / count(*), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.reviews r on r.deal_id = d.deal_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by d.deal_type union all select d.deal_type, 'seller', round(sum(r.rating)::numeric / count(*), 2) from nlq.deals d join nlq.reviews r on r.deal_id = d.deal_id where r.reviewer_role = 'seller' group by d.deal_type

items.question: when both sides of a deal left a review, how often did they give each other the same number of stars?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((b.rating = s.rating)::int), 2) as same_pct from nlq.reviews b join nlq.reviews s on s.deal_id = b.deal_id and s.reviewer_role = 'seller' where b.reviewer_role = 'buyer'
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where min_r = max_r) / count(*), 2) from (select deal_id, min(rating) as min_r, max(rating) as max_r from nlq.reviews group by deal_id having count(distinct reviewer_role) = 2) x

items.question: which 2025 month saw the largest number of unique people finishing a deal, counting both sides of the trade?
items.gold_sql: with u as (select completed_on, buyer_id as id from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' union all select completed_on, seller_id from nlq.deals where status = 'completed') select date_trunc('month', completed_on)::date as month from u where completed_on between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1 order by count(distinct id) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select m as month from (select make_date(2025, extract(month from d.completed_on)::int, 1) as m, count(distinct s.student_id) as n from nlq.deals d join nlq.students s on s.student_id in (d.buyer_id, d.seller_id) where d.status = 'completed' and extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2025 group by 1) x order by n desc limit 1

items.question: which 3 categories get the most saves per listing?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.listings_all l left join nlq.saved_items s on s.item_id = l.item_id group by l.category order by count(s.item_id)::numeric / count(distinct l.item_id) desc limit 3
items.alt_sql: with saves as (select l.category, count(*) as n from nlq.saved_items s join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = s.item_id group by 1), listings as (select category, count(*) as n from nlq.listings_all group by 1) select listings.category from listings join saves on saves.category = listings.category order by saves.n::numeric / listings.n desc limit 3

items.question: late-return rate by meetup spot, only for spots with at least 300 returned rentals
items.gold_sql: select s.name, round(100.0 * avg(d.returned_late::int), 2) as late_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null group by s.name having count(*) >= 300
items.alt_sql: select name, late_pct from (select m.name, count(*) as returned, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where d.returned_late) / count(*), 2) as late_pct from nlq.meetup_spots m join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = m.spot_id join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.return_condition is not null group by m.name) x where returned >= 300

items.question: academic year by academic year, how much money came in from completed deals, and what was the percent change from the year before?
items.gold_sql: with y as (select c.academic_year, sum(d.agreed_price) as revenue from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.status = 'completed' group by c.academic_year) select academic_year, revenue, round(100.0 * (revenue - lag(revenue) over (order by academic_year)) / lag(revenue) over (order by academic_year), 1) as pct_change from y order by academic_year
items.alt_sql: with y as (select c.academic_year, sum(d.agreed_price) as revenue from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.completed_on = c.day where d.status = 'completed' group by 1) select cur.academic_year, cur.revenue, round(100.0 * (cur.revenue / prev.revenue - 1), 1) from y cur left join y prev on prev.academic_year = (left(cur.academic_year, 4)::int - 1)::text || '-' || right(left(cur.academic_year, 4), 2) order by 1

items.question: how many different sellers have posted 3 or more listings on the same day?
items.gold_sql: select count(distinct seller_id) from (select seller_id, listed_on from nlq.listings_all group by seller_id, listed_on having count(*) >= 3) x
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from (select seller_id from (select seller_id, count(*) over (partition by seller_id, listed_on) as n from nlq.listings_all) x where n >= 3 group by seller_id) y

items.question: what's the second most common category among listings at off-campus meetup spots?
items.gold_sql: select category from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where s.area = 'off campus' group by category order by count(*) desc offset 1 limit 1
items.alt_sql: select category from (select l.category, dense_rank() over (order by count(*) desc) as rk from nlq.meetup_spots m join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = m.spot_id where m.area = 'off campus' group by l.category) x where rk = 2

items.question: at which meetup spot do sellers get the highest average rating from buyers on completed sales?
items.gold_sql: select s.name from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by s.name order by avg(r.rating) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: with x as (select m.name, avg(r.rating) as a from nlq.meetup_spots m join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = m.spot_id join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' join nlq.reviews r on r.deal_id = d.deal_id and r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by m.name) select name from x where a = (select max(a) from x)

items.question: of the students who returned a rental damaged, how many made another rental request after that return?
items.gold_sql: select count(distinct d.buyer_id) from nlq.deals d where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.return_condition = 'damaged' and exists (select 1 from nlq.deals e where e.buyer_id = d.buyer_id and e.deal_type = 'rental' and e.requested_at > d.rental_returned_at)
items.alt_sql: with dmg as (select buyer_id, min(rental_returned_at) as first_damaged from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' and return_condition = 'damaged' group by buyer_id), last_req as (select buyer_id, max(requested_at) as latest from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'rental' group by buyer_id) select count(*) from dmg join last_req using (buyer_id) where last_req.latest > dmg.first_damaged

items.question: for each academic year, how many listings did the average seller post?
items.gold_sql: select c.academic_year, round(count(*)::numeric / count(distinct l.seller_id), 2) as listings_per_seller from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on group by c.academic_year
items.alt_sql: select academic_year, round(avg(n), 2) from (select c.academic_year, l.seller_id, count(*) as n from nlq.calendar c join nlq.listings_all l on l.listed_on = c.day group by 1, 2) x group by academic_year

items.question: of the listings that got at least one declined request, what share eventually sold?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((l.status = 'sold')::int), 2) as sold_pct from nlq.listings_all l where exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.item_id = l.item_id and d.status = 'declined')
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where l.status = 'sold') / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all l join (select distinct item_id from nlq.deals where status = 'declined') x on x.item_id = l.item_id

items.question: how many days does it take on average to go from request to completion, sales compared with rentals?
items.gold_sql: select deal_type, round(avg(extract(epoch from completed_at - requested_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' group by deal_type
items.alt_sql: select 'sale' as kind, round((avg(extract(epoch from completed_at - requested_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and deal_type = 'sale' union all select 'rental', round((avg(extract(epoch from completed_at - requested_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' and deal_type = 'rental'

items.question: how many listings were saved by at least 5 different students but never sold?
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select s.item_id from nlq.saved_items s join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = s.item_id where l.status <> 'sold' group by s.item_id having count(distinct s.student_id) >= 5) x
items.alt_sql: select count(*) from nlq.listings_all l where l.status <> 'sold' and (select count(distinct student_id) from nlq.saved_items s where s.item_id = l.item_id) >= 5

items.question: in 2025, which weekday and category combination had the most completed sales?
items.gold_sql: select c.weekday_name, l.category from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.year = 2025 group by 1, 2 order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select weekday_name, category from (select c.weekday_name, l.category, rank() over (order by count(*) desc) as rk from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on d.completed_on = c.day and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where c.day between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1, 2) x where rk = 1

items.question: consistency check: count sellers who closed at least one sale during the fall term in each of 2023, 2024 and 2025
items.gold_sql: select count(*) from (select d.seller_id from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year in ('2023-24', '2024-25', '2025-26') group by d.seller_id having count(distinct c.academic_year) = 3) x
items.alt_sql: with f as (select distinct d.seller_id, c.academic_year from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and c.semester = 'Fall') select count(*) from (select seller_id from f where academic_year = '2023-24' intersect select seller_id from f where academic_year = '2024-25' intersect select seller_id from f where academic_year = '2025-26') x

items.question: break completed sales into price bands: free, under $25, $25 to under $50, $50 to under $100, and $100 or more. how many in each?
items.gold_sql: select case when agreed_price = 0 then 'free' when agreed_price < 25 then 'under 25' when agreed_price < 50 then '25 to 50' when agreed_price < 100 then '50 to 100' else '100+' end as band, count(*) as sales from nlq.deals where deal_type = 'sale' and status = 'completed' group by 1
items.alt_sql: select b.band, count(d.deal_id) from (values ('free', 0, 0.001), ('under 25', 0.001, 25), ('25 to 50', 25, 50), ('50 to 100', 50, 100), ('100+', 100, 1000000)) as b(band, lo, hi) join nlq.deals d on d.agreed_price >= b.lo and d.agreed_price < b.hi where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by b.band

items.question: for each category, divide the number of rentals that went through by the number of sales that went through
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(count(*) filter (where d.deal_type = 'rental')::numeric / count(*) filter (where d.deal_type = 'sale'), 2) as rentals_per_sale from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.status = 'completed' group by l.category
items.alt_sql: with r as (select l.category, sum(case when d.deal_type = 'rental' then 1 else 0 end) as rentals, sum(case when d.deal_type = 'sale' then 1 else 0 end) as sales from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.status = 'completed' group by 1) select category, round(rentals::numeric / nullif(sales, 0), 2) from r

items.question: listing funnel: what percent of all listings ever posted got a chat, what percent got a purchase or rental request, and what percent ended in a completed deal?
items.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.conversations c where c.item_id = l.item_id))::int), 2) as chat_pct, round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.item_id = l.item_id))::int), 2) as request_pct, round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.item_id = l.item_id and d.status = 'completed'))::int), 2) as completed_pct from nlq.listings_all l
items.alt_sql: select round(100.0 * (select count(distinct item_id) from nlq.conversations) / count(*), 2) as a, round(100.0 * (select count(distinct item_id) from nlq.deals) / count(*), 2) as b, round(100.0 * (select count(distinct item_id) from nlq.deals where status = 'completed') / count(*), 2) as c from nlq.listings_all

items.question: of the students who completed a deal in fall 2024, as buyer or seller, what percent also completed one in fall 2025?
items.gold_sql: with f as (select c.academic_year, x.id from (select completed_on, buyer_id as id from nlq.deals where status = 'completed' union all select completed_on, seller_id from nlq.deals where status = 'completed') x join nlq.calendar c on c.day = x.completed_on where c.semester = 'Fall' and c.academic_year in ('2024-25', '2025-26') group by 1, 2) select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from f g where g.id = f.id and g.academic_year = '2025-26')) / count(*), 2) as retained_pct from f where academic_year = '2024-25'
items.alt_sql: with a as (select distinct s.student_id, c.academic_year from nlq.students s join nlq.deals d on s.student_id in (d.buyer_id, d.seller_id) and d.status = 'completed' join nlq.calendar c on c.day = d.completed_on and c.semester = 'Fall') select round(100.0 * count(b.student_id) / count(*), 2) from a left join a b on b.student_id = a.student_id and b.academic_year = '2025-26' where a.academic_year = '2024-25'

items.question: median seller reply time in hours for chats about on-campus listings vs off-campus ones
items.gold_sql: select s.area, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as median_hours from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = c.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where c.first_seller_reply_at is not null group by s.area
items.alt_sql: with h as (select m.area, extract(epoch from c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at) / 3600 as hrs, row_number() over (partition by m.area order by c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at) as rn, count(*) over (partition by m.area) as n from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = c.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots m on m.spot_id = l.spot_id where c.first_seller_reply_at is not null) select area, round(avg(hrs)::numeric, 2) from h where rn in ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2) group by area
accept_sql: select s.area, round(percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from c.first_seller_reply_at - c.started_at) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as median_hours from nlq.conversations c join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = c.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where c.first_seller_reply_at is not null group by s.area

items.question: for each category, what percent of listings sold within a week of going up?
items.gold_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * avg((exists (select 1 from nlq.deals d where d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_at - l.listed_at <= interval '7 days'))::int), 2) as pct_within_week from nlq.listings_all l group by l.category
items.alt_sql: select l.category, round(100.0 * count(d.item_id) / count(*), 2) from nlq.listings_all l left join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and extract(epoch from d.completed_at - l.listed_at) <= 7 * 86400 group by l.category

items.question: which school year had the worst damage rate on items coming back from rentals?
items.gold_sql: select c.academic_year from nlq.deals d join nlq.calendar c on c.day = (d.rental_returned_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null group by c.academic_year order by avg((d.return_condition = 'damaged')::int) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select academic_year from (select c.academic_year, rank() over (order by count(*) filter (where d.return_condition = 'damaged')::numeric / count(*) desc) as rk from nlq.calendar c join nlq.deals d on c.day = d.rental_due_date where d.return_condition is not null group by 1) x where rk = 1

items.question: on average, how many chats did listings that sold get, compared with listings that were taken down?
items.gold_sql: select l.status, round(avg((select count(*) from nlq.conversations c where c.item_id = l.item_id)), 2) as avg_chats from nlq.listings_all l where l.status in ('sold', 'removed') group by l.status
items.alt_sql: select l.status, round(count(c.conversation_id)::numeric / count(distinct l.item_id), 2) from nlq.listings_all l left join nlq.conversations c on c.item_id = l.item_id where l.status in ('sold', 'removed') group by l.status

items.question: right now, which pickup spot has the largest number of live listings?
items.gold_sql: select meetup_spot from nlq.listings group by meetup_spot order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select name from (select meetup_spot as name, rank() over (order by count(*) desc) as rk from nlq.listings group by meetup_spot) x where rk = 1

items.question: which three product types generated the highest revenue from sales in 2025?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and extract(year from d.completed_on) = 2025 group by l.category order by sum(d.agreed_price) desc limit 3
items.alt_sql: select category from (select l.category, sum(d.agreed_price) as rev from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' and d.completed_on between '2025-01-01' and '2025-12-31' group by 1) x order by rev desc limit 3

items.question: in 2024, which month did people write the most reviews in?
items.gold_sql: select date_trunc('month', reviewed_on)::date as month from nlq.reviews where extract(year from reviewed_on) = 2024 group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select make_date(2024, c.month, 1) as month from nlq.reviews r join nlq.calendar c on c.day = r.reviewed_on where c.year = 2024 group by c.month order by count(*) desc limit 1

items.question: on purchases, which category gets the highest average star rating from the people who bought from them?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.reviews r join nlq.deals d on d.deal_id = r.deal_id join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' and d.deal_type = 'sale' group by l.category order by avg(r.rating) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: with x as (select l.category, avg(r.rating) as a from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' join nlq.reviews r on r.deal_id = d.deal_id and r.reviewer_role = 'buyer' group by 1) select category from x where a = (select max(a) from x)

items.question: which item condition fetches the highest average agreed price on completed sales?
items.gold_sql: select l.condition from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by l.condition order by avg(d.agreed_price) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select condition from (select l.condition, rank() over (order by avg(d.agreed_price) desc) as rk from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and d.status = 'completed' group by 1) x where rk = 1

items.question: what day of the week do the most new listings get posted?
items.gold_sql: select c.weekday_name from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.calendar c on c.day = l.listed_on group by c.weekday_name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select to_char(listed_on, 'FMDay') as weekday from nlq.listings_all group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 1

items.question: where were purchase requests most concentrated in 2024, by pickup location, counting requests regardless of outcome?
items.gold_sql: select s.name from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where d.deal_type = 'sale' and extract(year from d.requested_on) = 2024 group by s.name order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select m.name from nlq.meetup_spots m join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = m.spot_id join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id and d.deal_type = 'sale' where d.requested_on between '2024-01-01' and '2024-12-31' group by m.name order by count(d.deal_id) desc limit 1

items.question: is lateness on rentals worse for off-campus pickups than on-campus ones? give the late percentage for each area
items.gold_sql: select s.area, round(100.0 * avg(d.returned_late::int), 2) as late_pct from nlq.deals d join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = d.item_id join nlq.meetup_spots s on s.spot_id = l.spot_id where d.deal_type = 'rental' and d.rental_returned_at is not null group by s.area
items.alt_sql: select m.area, round(100.0 * sum(case when d.returned_late then 1 else 0 end) / count(*), 2) from nlq.meetup_spots m join nlq.listings_all l on l.spot_id = m.spot_id join nlq.deals d on d.item_id = l.item_id where d.return_condition is not null group by m.area

items.question: 2024-25 school year: were there more new accounts in the fall term or the spring term?
items.gold_sql: select c.semester from nlq.students s join nlq.calendar c on c.day = (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date where c.academic_year = '2024-25' and c.semester in ('Fall', 'Spring') group by c.semester order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select case when count(*) filter (where c.semester = 'Fall') > count(*) filter (where c.semester = 'Spring') then 'Fall' else 'Spring' end from nlq.calendar c join nlq.students s on (s.joined_at at time zone 'America/New_York')::date = c.day where c.academic_year = '2024-25'

items.question: which category has been saved the most times?
items.gold_sql: select l.category from nlq.saved_items s join nlq.listings_all l on l.item_id = s.item_id group by l.category order by count(*) desc limit 1
items.alt_sql: select category from (select l.category, count(*) as n from nlq.listings_all l join nlq.saved_items s on s.item_id = l.item_id group by 1) x order by n desc limit 1
